name: Can under-cabinet lighting be installed in existing kitchens?
description: Under-cabinet lighting can be installed in most existing kitchens, with hardwired options offering a cleaner look.

mainEntity.name: Can under-cabinet lighting be installed in existing kitchens?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, under-cabinet lighting can be installed in most existing kitchens. The process typically involves either hardwiring the fixtures into your home's electrical system or using plug-in options. Hardwiring provides a cleaner, integrated look, but may require minor electrical work to conceal wires. Hometelligent Inc. specializes in seamless integration, often identifying optimal wiring paths during the initial walkthrough to avoid visible conduits.
